judged_text: The PUT /admin/customize/embedding route, EmbeddingController#update, and the client's saveChanges() action (admin-embedding.js.es6:5-7) form a no-op circuit: update ignores its params and re-serializes the same OpenStruct, so saving does nothing. Ships-inert feature: operators get a save endpoint that silently persists nothing; any client or integration that calls update({}) believes changes were saved when they were not. Under-scoped relative to the 'edit embedding' intent — only host CRUD actually works.

adjudication.rationale: Diff shows Admin::EmbeddingController#update is effectively a no-op: it ignores params and just `render_serialized(@embedding, ...)` where `@embedding` is an OpenStruct built in `fetch_embedding` from `EmbeddableHost.all.order(:host)` (app/controllers/admin/embedding_controller.rb). The client controller has `saveChanges() { this.get('embedding').update({}); }` (admin-embedding.js.es6), which would PUT to `/admin/customize/embedding` (adapter pathFor). However, the embedding UI template (admin/templates/embedding.hbs) does not call `saveChanges` or present fields to save—host CRUD is handled via `embeddable-host` records/controllers—so this is more an inert/unused endpoint/action and scope/API design concern than a user-visible broken behavior proven by the diff.
